title: Step 4a: Comparing Real vs Predicted Profits in Linear Regression - Hands-on Gui

cues.en: -: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's predict the test set results.
cues.zh: 預測測試集結果。

cues.en: So as I said in the previous tutorial, we're gonna display two vectors.
cues.zh: 如上一堂所說，要顯示兩個向量。

cues.en: First one being the vector of the real profits and the test set, and the second one being the vector of the predicted profits in the same test set.
cues.zh: 第一個是測試集的實際利潤，第二個是同一測試集的預測利潤。

cues.en: And we're gonna compare next to each other, to see if our predictions are close to the real results.
cues.zh: 把它們並排，看看預測是否接近真實結果。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's start by creating a new code cell.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式儲存格。

cues.en: So the first thing I asked you to do, was to indeed get that vector of predictions.
cues.zh: 先前請你先取得預測向量。

cues.en: So, first, since we wanna get a vector I'm going to introduce a new variable, which I'm gonna call as usual, Y pred.
cues.zh: 既然要得到向量，就先新增變數，照慣例叫 y_pred。

cues.en: So that's gonna be the vector of the predicted profits in the test set.
cues.zh: 它會保存測試集的預測利潤。

cues.en: And now, how do we get our predictions?
cues.zh: 要如何取得？

cues.en: Well, you know the solution, it's actually exactly the same as, with simple in our regression.
cues.zh: 做法和簡單線性迴歸完全相同。

cues.en: We first need to take our regressor object, you know, our multiple in our regression model from which we're gonna call that predict method.
cues.zh: 先取出 regressor，也就是多元線性迴歸模型，再呼叫 predict。

cues.en: And of course, in this method we have to input the features of the test set, you know, exactly these ones not including the profit, of course.
cues.zh: 傳入測試集的特徵，當然不包含 Profit。

cues.en: These are all the features with first the encoded variables for the state, then the R&D spend, and the administration spend, and the marketing spend.
cues.zh: 包括最前面的州別編碼，再來研發、行政與行銷支出。

cues.en: All right, so these are all the features which we need to input in our predict method here in order to predict the profits.
cues.zh: 這些就是預測利潤時，要傳入 predict 的特徵。

cues.en: So let's do this X test.
cues.zh: 所以填 X_test。

cues.en: And there you go, now we get our vector of predicted profits.
cues.zh: 完成，已得到預測利潤向量。

cues.en: Perfect. And now the next step the thing that I'm gonna do is I'm gonna call NumPy, which has a shortcut NP, from which I'm gonna call one
cues.zh: 下一步，呼叫簡稱 np 的 NumPy，再使用其中的

cues.en: of its function, which is set underscore print options.
cues.zh: set_printoptions 函式。

cues.en: And now in the parenthesis, I'm just going to enter precision equals two, all right?
cues.zh: 括號中設定 precision=2。

cues.en: And this will display any numerical value with only two decimals after comma.
cues.zh: 這會讓數值顯示到小數點後兩位。

cues.en: All right? So this will be much more beautiful to visualize and mostly much easier to visualize.
cues.zh: 看起來更整齊，也更容易比較。

cues.en: Okay, good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now final step.
cues.zh: 最後一步。

cues.en: This is a step where we're going to display the two vectors of the real profits and of the predicted profits together next to each other.
cues.zh: 要把實際利潤與預測利潤兩個向量，並排顯示。

cues.en: And to do this, well, we're gonna use, you know a classic trick with NumPy, concatenate.
cues.zh: 使用 NumPy 常見的技巧，concatenate。

cues.en: Concatenate is a function of NumPy that allows to concatenate either vertically or horizontally, two vectors or even arrays.
cues.zh: concatenate 可以垂直或水平串接兩個向量，甚至陣列。

cues.en: And so now we're gonna use the concatenate function to concatenate vertically our two vectors of the real profits and the breaked profits.
cues.zh: 現在會用它，將實際與預測利潤整理成垂直顯示的兩欄。

cues.en: All right, So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Just follow me, I will explain everything as I'm coding.
cues.zh: 跟著做，我邊寫邊解釋。

cues.en: So first, we're simply going to start with a print you know, because we want to print that concatenation of the two vectors.
cues.zh: 先寫 print，因為要輸出兩個向量串接後的結果。

cues.en: Then here we go, we're gonna call that concatenate function by NumPy, from which, there we go, we call the concatenate function.
cues.zh: 再呼叫 NumPy 的 concatenate 函式。

cues.en: Perfect, parenthesis.
cues.zh: 加括號。

cues.en: And now be careful because this is always a bit confusing.
cues.zh: 這裡要小心，常會有點混淆。

cues.en: The concatenate function by NumPy actually expect as a first argument, check this out here, the (indistinct) of a raise you want to concatenate, or you know, vectors.
cues.zh: concatenate 第一個引數，是要串接的陣列或向量序列。

cues.en: So actually all the description is here.
cues.zh: 說明就在這裡。

cues.en: You know, A one, A two is a sequence of a raise you want to concatenate and that must have the same shape.
cues.zh: a1、a2 代表要串接的陣列序列，它們必須有相容的形狀。

cues.en: Well, that's perfect for us, because of course our vector of predicted profits and the vector of real profits have exactly the same shape, meaning there are one dimensional vector containing the same number of profits.
cues.zh: 對我們很合適，因為預測利潤與實際利潤都是同樣大小的一維向量，包含相同數量的利潤值。

cues.en: Okay, so that's good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: But these vectors that we want to concatenate have to be in, you know, some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 但這些向量必須放在一組括號中。

cues.en: And these are actually the first argument, you know, this double of arrays of vectors is the first argument input in parenthesis.
cues.zh: 這個由陣列或向量組成的 tuple，整體才是第一個引數。

cues.en: So here I'm gonna add new parenthesis.
cues.zh: 所以再加一組括號。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: This is the first argument.
cues.zh: 這是第一個引數。

cues.en: And what is going to be inside these parenthesis, well, of course are two vectors: the vector of predicted profits and the vector Of real profits.
cues.zh: 括號裡當然是兩個向量：預測利潤與實際利潤。

cues.en: All right, so let's first add the vector of predicted profits.
cues.zh: 先加入預測利潤向量。

cues.en: This is of course y pred.
cues.zh: 也就是 y_pred。

cues.en: And now because we want to display them vertically and not horizontally, remember that, you know actually I can show this to you in data preprocessing tools.
cues.zh: 但我們想垂直顯示，而不是水平。可以回到資料前處理工具看一下。

cues.en: We actually printed y at some point.
cues.zh: 之前曾輸出 y。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: Remember when we print the dependent variable vector since it is vector, it is displayed horizontally.
cues.zh: 依變數向量輸出時，因為是一維向量，會橫向顯示。

cues.en: I actually prefer to display, you know, our two vectors of predictions in real profit vertically.
cues.zh: 我比較想把預測與實際利潤兩個向量，都垂直顯示。

cues.en: So now I'm gonna add another trick to put that vertically you know, to convert that from being horizontal to vertical.
cues.zh: 因此再加個技巧，把它從橫向變成直向。

cues.en: And the trick to do that is just to add dot reshape.
cues.zh: 方法是接 .reshape。

cues.en: Reshape is an attribute function that allows to you know, reshape your vectors or arrays.
cues.zh: reshape 可以改變向量或陣列的形狀。

cues.en: And in order to reshape a vector from being horizontal to vertical, well, we just need to add as input of this function first the number of elements in Y pred, and that's actually
cues.zh: 要把向量改成垂直形式，第一個輸入是 y_pred 的元素數，

cues.en: so far the number of columns, because you know it is horizontal.
cues.zh: 也就是目前橫向顯示時的數值個數。

cues.en: And to get that number, we can simply use the len function, which returns the length of a vector.
cues.zh: 取得數量可以用 len，它會傳回向量長度。

cues.en: And therefore, here I'm going to input Y pred.
cues.zh: 所以這裡寫 len(y_pred)。

cues.en: Okay? So this is the first element of the reshape function, and the second one is just one.
cues.zh: 這是 reshape 的第一個引數，第二個是 1。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, what does it mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: That means you want to reshape your Y pred vector into an array, having len Y pred rows, meaning you know that the number of rows will be equal to the number of startups,
cues.zh: 就是把 y_pred 改成 len(y_pred) 列，也就是列數等於新創公司數量的陣列，

cues.en: and then just one column.
cues.zh: 而且只有一欄。

cues.en: All right? That's what it means.
cues.zh: 就是這個意思。

cues.en: So it's good that you know this reshape trick.
cues.zh: 這個 reshape 技巧非常值得學。

cues.en: Now you know how to reshape your vectors and you will see that it is actually gonna be much nicer.
cues.zh: 現在你已知道如何改變向量形狀，稍後會看到，結果整齊得多。
